KWTA staff to be redeployed immediately, CS Duale assures

Environment, Climate Change and Forestry Cabinet Secretary Hon. Aden Duale has assured that all staff of the defunct Kenya Waters Towers Agency (KWTA) will be redeployed to the Ministry and its agencies based on their identified competencies.

Speaking to staff of KWTA, dissolved in December 2024 after the expiry of its legal mandate, Hon. Duale, who was accompanied by Principal Secretaries Gitonga Mugambi (Forestry) and Dr. Eng. Festus Ng'eno (Environment and Climate Change) said the Ministry had finalized the placement list. 

At the meeting held at the Kenya Meteorological Department (KMD) headquarters in Nairobi, CS Duale announced that 68 and 45 employees will be redeployed to Environment and Climate Change, and Forestry state departments respectively.

In developing the placement list, Hon. Duale said the Ministry considered qualifications, rank, skills, experience and other intervening factors including age and disability if any and current duty station.

At the same time, Hon. Duale rallied the former KWTA staff to strictly observe the public service code of conduct  and principles of good governance as they move into their new stations. 

He urged the staff to strive and maintain a high level of professionalism and integrity.

The defunct KWTA was 
established through Legal Notice No. 27 of 20th April, 2012 with the mandate to 
coordinate and oversee the protection, rehabilitation, conservation and sustainable management of water towers in Kenya.

KWTA was dissolved following the Cabinet sanctioned rationalisation of State Corporations with overlapping and /or duplicate mandates.

Through financial support, technology transfer, and policy collaboration, Kenya can strengthen its waste management framework, invest in sustainable alternatives, and create more green jobs.

Liberia and Sierra Leone Highlight Gola Rainforest Conservation at COP 16

At a side event on October 25, 2024, on the sidelines of the UN Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD) COP 16, Dr. Emmanuel K. Urey Yarkpawolo, Executive Director of Liberia’s Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), joined Sierra Leone's Minister of Environment and Climate Change, Minister Jiwoh Abdulai, to share insights on transboundary conservation initiatives in the Gola Rainforest.

The session centered on the innovative collaboration between local communities, civil society, and governments in Liberia and Sierra Leone to protect the Gola Rainforest and implement the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework. Highlighting their achievements, the event featured audiovisual presentations showcasing community-led conservation projects within the Gola landscape, followed by a panel discussion where attendees engaged directly with the panelists.

Liberia Signs Scholarship Agreement for Climate Law and Governance Course at COP 29

BAKU, Azerbaijan – The Government of Liberia, through the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), has signed a scholarship agreement with the University of Cambridge’s Democratizing Education for Global Sustainability and Justice Programme. The agreement was signed on Tuesday, November 19, during the COP 29 Climate Conference in Baku.

The deal will enable 150 Liberians to enroll in an online course titled “Climate Law and Governance.” The course will be taught by Professors from around the World including Cambridge University.   It is a non-credit two week or 8-10 hours’ online course that will certificate participants at the end of the course. 

Speaking at the signing ceremony, Dr. Emmanuel K. Urey Yarkpawolo, Executive Director of the EPA, expressed gratitude to the Centre for Sustainable Development and the University of Cambridge for their support.

“On behalf of the Government of Liberia and our team here in Baku, we want to thank the Centre for Sustainable Development and the University of Cambridge for this opportunity,” Dr. Urey Yarkpawolo said. “This program will build the capacity of Liberians interested in environmental law and governance, which is vital as we work on developing our climate law. The course is estimated at a market value of 1,800 GBP each per participant and if 150 Liberians benefit, this is 1,800 GBP  times 150, which is 270,000 GBP. This huge and we are very grateful for this initiatives”, the EPA Boss emphasized.  

Professor Marie-Claire Cordonier Segger, representing the Democratizing Education for Global Sustainability and Justice Programme, shared her enthusiasm about the partnership. “We are delighted to collaborate with the EPA to offer this course to Liberia. The course aligns with the goals of the Paris Agreement and will strengthen legal capacity in sustainable development, which borders on law and policy,”. She added that the program’s mission is to democratize education on sustainable development and provide legal training globally. 

Anyone who has obtained a Bachelor Degree and is passionate about the Paris Agreement on Climate Change and Sustainable Development can take the course. The EPA will come out with application criteria and will inform the public. 

This initiative is expected to enhance Liberia's efforts in environmental governance and sustainable development as the country navigates the challenges of climate change.

The event was witnessed by Hon. Philip C. Parker, the Chairman of the Board of Directors of the Forestry Development Authority and Hon. Ansu V. S. Dulleh Sr. , the Director General of the National Disaster Management Agency, as well as a host of governmental officials and civil society actors representing Liberia at the COP29 taking place in Baku, Azerbaijan.

EPA and NPHIL Sign Lead Paint Regulations 

(Monrovia, Liberia, January 8, 2025)– In an effort aimed at moving to protect public health and the environment, the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) of Liberia and the National Public Health Institute of Liberia (NPHIL) have officially signed the Lead Paint Regulations. 

The signing ceremony held on Wednesday, January 8, 2024, at the EPA’s conference hall, brought together representatives from both institutions and other stakeholders. 
 
The regulation limits the lead content in residential and decorative paints to 90 parts per million (ppm), aligning with ECOWAS standards, and aims to eliminate the production, sale, and importation of lead-based paints in Liberia within three years. 

Mr. Jerry Toe, Focal Point for the Lead Paint Regulation, in his opening remarks, described the regulation as a major achievement. "This is not just a regulatory milestone but a testament to the collaborative efforts of stakeholders who have worked tirelessly to protect public health," he said.  

Mr. Toe highlighted that lead exposure remains a critical public health challenge in developing countries like Liberia. 
 
Giving the overview of the regulations, Mr. Rafael Ngumbu, EPA’s Manager of Environmental Research and Radiation Safety, provided an overview of the regulation’s development. He noted that stakeholder consultations began in August 2019, leading to the formation of a technical working group in 2021. 

He said a study conducted by a UK team revealed dangerously high lead levels in locally produced paints, prompting urgent action. 

Mr. Ngumbu further explained that the regulation follows Liberia’s 
Environmental Management Law, which mandates collaboration between EPA, NPHIL, and other agencies to develop standards aimed at reducing environmental hazards. 
 
Speaking during the signing ceremony, Dr. Emmanuel King Urey Yarkpawolo, EPA’s Executive Director, emphasized the devastating impact of lead exposure on human health, particularly children and pregnant women.  

"Lead poisoning causes irreversible damage to the brain and nervous system, decreases IQ, and increases the risk of behavioral problems," he explained.  
 
He thanked the Liberian government, NPHIL, and international partners like the Lead Exposure Elimination Project (LEEP) for their support in drafting and implementing the regulation. 
 
Dr. Urey Yarkpawolo noted that lead in paint is a significant source of exposure, especially as paints decay and release toxic dust and flakes into the environment.  

He assured the public of the EPA’s commitment to strict implementation, including testing paint samples, creating awareness, and supporting manufacturers in transitioning to lead-free production. 
 
For his part, the Director General of National Public Health Institute of Liberia (NPHIL), Dr. Dougbeh Chris Nyan described the signing as a “historical milestone” and stressed the importance of enforcing the regulation.  

"This is not just another signing ceremony. It’s about ensuring that our enforcement teams go out and monitor compliance, especially among manufacturers producing lead-based paints," Dr. Nyan stated. 
 
Dr. Nyan also highlighted the collaboration between EPA and NPHIL as a model for inter-agency cooperation, ensuring that public health and environmental protection are addressed holistically. 

"As President Boakai has said, this will not be business as usual. Implementation and enforcement will be key," he added. 
 
The EPA, in partnership with LEEP, plans to expand studies on lead content in paints, raise public awareness, provide technical advice to manufacturers for reformulating paints, and monitor compliance. 
 
The signing of the Lead Paint Regulations signifies a shared commitment by EPA, NPHIL, and partners to create a healthier and lead-free Liberia. This milestone aims to eliminate a significant source of human exposure to lead, safeguarding public health and ensuring a cleaner environment for future generations.

President Boakai Appoints EPA Director to Lead Taskforce for Protecting Liberia's Coastal and Wetland Ecosystems

(Monrovia, Liberia, February 24, 2025) – President Joseph Nyuma Boakai has appointed Dr. Emmanuel K. Urey Yarkpawolo, Executive Director of the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), as the chair of a newly formed Taskforce dedicated to safeguarding Liberia's beachfronts, waterways, and wetlands. This initiative is a part of Executive Order No. 143, which aims to combat environmental degradation and enhance conservation efforts across the nation.

In a statement released from the Executive Mansion on February 24, 2025, President Boakai emphasized that the taskforce was established to address increasing concerns regarding pollution, erosion, and climate change that jeopardize Liberia's coastal and wetland ecosystems. 

He stated, “The unchecked destruction and pollution of wetlands, waterways, and beachfronts pose serious risks to both the environment and the livelihoods of Liberians.”

The Taskforce, under Dr. Yarkpawolo's leadership, will collaborate closely with various government agencies to enforce environmental regulations and protect the country's natural resources. The Chairman of the Liberia Land Authority will serve as co-chair, with additional members including the Ministers of Justice, Internal Affairs, Public Works, Mines and Energy, as well as Information, Cultural Affairs, and Tourism. The Liberia National Police and local municipal authorities will also be integral to enforcement efforts.

The Executive Mansion release highlighted the key responsibilities of the Taskforce, which include halting illegal destruction and backfilling of wetlands, restoring damaged areas, supporting local conservation initiatives, and ensuring accountability for violators through legal means. 

Additionally, the Taskforce aims to raise public awareness regarding the environmental and economic benefits of preserving these ecosystems and to discourage the use of harmful, non-eco-friendly pesticides.

Liberia has been committed to wetland conservation since signing the Ramsar Convention in 2003, and Executive Order No. 143 bolsters these efforts by enhancing enforcement and promoting cooperation among government agencies. The Taskforce will work in conjunction with the National Climate Change Steering Committee to adopt a comprehensive approach to environmental protection.

President Boakai has mandated immediate execution of the order and urges all citizens, businesses, and local communities to support this initiative. "Protecting Liberia’s natural heritage is vital for the country’s long-term development and sustainability," the Executive Mansion affirmed.

With Dr. Urey Yarkpawolo leading the Taskforce, there are high expectations for stronger environmental protections, ensuring that Liberia’s beaches, waterways, and wetlands are preserved for future generations.

Journée mondiale de l'Ozone : _Faire progresser l'action climatique_

Le Ministre de l’Environnement, de la Protection de la Nature et du Développement Durable, HELE Pierre, accompagné du Dr NANA Aboubakar DJALLOH a procédé hier lundi 16 septembre 2024, au lancement officiel du projet de mise en œuvre des amendements de Kigali sur les Hydrofluorocarbures (HFC), à l'occasion de la cérémonie commémorative de la 37e édition de la Journée Mondiale de l'Ozone. Les activités qui se sont déroulées à la Salle des délibérations de l’Hôtel de Ville de Yaoundé étaient placées sous le thème *« Protocole de Montréal : Faire progresser l’action climatique »*. 

Y ont pris part M. Raymond TAVARES le Représentant Résident de l'Organisation des Nations Unies pour le Développement Industriel (ONUDI), le Président du Conseil d'Administration de l'Observatoire National sur les Changements Climatiques (ONACC) M. ENOW Peter AYUK, les membres du Bureau Ozone, l'association des professionnels de froid et climatisation du Cameroun et les établissements scolaires lauréats du concours organisé dans le cadre de la Journée Mondiale.

HELE Pierre dans son intervention a lancé un appel à toutes les parties prenantes à se tourner vers l'avenir pour approfondir et accélérer l’action mondiale dans le cadre du Protocole de Montréal non seulement pour la couche d’ozone, mais aussi pour les populations, le climat et la planète. Pour cela, elles doivent intensifier la traque contre les systèmes de réfrigération, de climatisation et des pompes à chaleur émettrices de HFC et ralentir le réchauffement climatique. 

L’amendement de Kigali est un accord historique dans lequel les 197 Etats signataires du Protocole de Montréal promettent de mettre fin d’ici 2050 aux hydrofluorocarbures.

Un Atelier d'échanges avec les acteurs clés du secteur privé et de la recherche scientifique concernés par les chaînes de valeur de la biodiversité au Cameroun s'est tenu les 26 et 27 novembre 2024 à Mbankomo. 

S'inscrivant en prélude de la tenue du Forum National sur les ressources génétiques, la rencontre présidée par Dr. DINGOM Aurélie Taylor, Inspecteur N°2 et  Point Focal APA, représentant Monsieur le Ministre de l'Environnement pour cette circonstance, a regroupé une cinquantaine de participants.
L'objectif : consulter et dialoguer avec les acteurs de la recherche et du secteur privé, afin de faciliter leur appropriation et leur préparation pour une participation efficace au Forum en gestation sur les ressources génétiques du Cameroun. 

 Il importe de rappeler que l'ambition du Cameroun de transformer structurellement son économie à travers le développement des industries de services basées sur la biodiversité est clairement mentionnée dans la Stratégie Nationale de Développement (SND 30). En effet, la biodiversité en tant que facteur de production est au centre des systèmes économiques contemporains. Elle est essentielle pour satisfaire les demandes sans cesse croissantes de consommation dans le monde. 

Annoncé pour le mois de janvier, le Forum National sur les ressources génétiques rassemblera les parties prenantes et acteurs impliqués directement ou indirectement dans la bioprospection , la recherche, le développement de la chaîne de valeur et d'approvisionnement, ainsi que  autres activités commerciales liées à l'utilisation des ressources génétiques au Cameroun. Avec notamment pour ambition de promouvoir un tissu industriel de PME qui transforment et valorisent la biodiversité locale , dans une optique d'amélioration des conditions de vie des populations et de l'économie nationale dans son ensemble.

Un atelier de réflexion et de concertation a réuni hier mardi 10 décembre à Mbankomo des professionnels de la communication ( journalistes et communicateurs) issus des médias publics et privés. Ils étaient aux côtés de la Cellule de Communication du MINEPDED et de l'équipe  du projet APA pour préparer la communication autour du Forum National sur les Ressources Génétiques en projet, ainsi qu'autour du processus APA au Cameroun d'une manière générale. 

Après les allocutions de Dr DINGOM Aurélie Taylor, Directrice Nationale du Projet APA et du représentant de la GIZ, partenaire de mise en oeuvre du Forum National sur les ressources génétiques, la journée s'est articulée autour d'exposés et  de travaux de groupes, tous ponctués d'interventions de haute facture. 

Comme résultat de cette session intensive, le Forum National sur les Ressources Génétiques et le processus APA au Cameroun bénéficient de l'adhésion des médias participants (Radio, télévision, presse écrite et digitale...). Ils savent ce qui se prépare et quelle est leur contribution attendue pour faire de cet événement inédit, un succès médiatique avant, pendant et après sa tenue.  Les recommandations ont été suffisamment claires et seront incorporées à la stratégie d'ensemble par le comité de préparation et d'organisation du Forum National sur les ressources génétiques.

Le Secrétaire Général du MINEPDED Prof. Paul TCHAWA, représentant Monsieur le Ministre en charge de l'Environnement, a présidé ce lundi 17 février à l'ouverture de l' atelier de sensibilisation et d'information sur l'initiative pour le financement de la Biodiversité au Cameroun ( BIOFIN). 

C'était en présence de Madame BEYALA Joséphine Epse ELOUNDOU, Inspecteur Général du MINEPDED et Point Focal National de la Convention sur la Biodiversité (CBD). 

Le Cameroun s'est engagé à réviser la deuxième version de ses Stratégie et Plan d'action national de la Biodiversité (NBSAP II), conformément au Cadre mondial de Kunming-Montréal et à la Stratégie Nationale de Développement (SND 30). La mise en oeuvre de ce NBSAP II nécessite la mobilisation d'importantes ressources financières internes et externes. 

C'est ce qui justifie l'organisation de cet Atelier sur le BIOFIN. Il s'agit d'un outil développé dans certains pays et qui propose 150 solutions pour mieux identifier, diversifier et financer la biodiversité. L'initiative au Cameroun est implémentée par le MINEPDED avec le concours financier et technique du Fonds pour l'Environnement Mondial (FEM) et du Programme des Nations Unies pour le Développement (PNUD) à travers le projet Global Biodiversity Framework Early Action Support (GBF EAS). 

Au cours de ces deux jours d'atelier, les parties prenantes à la gestion de la Biodiversité seront informées et préparées au lancement prochain de l'initiative BIOFIN au Cameroun. 

"BIOFIN nous offre ainsi une voie innovante pour la mobilisation des ressources en exploitant des mécanismes financiers qui ont prouvé leur efficacité ailleurs, et qui sont adaptés à notre contexte, et en identifiant de potentielles sources de financement", a clarifié Monsieur le Secrétaire Général dans son allocution de circonstance.

በተቀናጀ የፖሊዮ ክትባት ዘመቻ ማስጀመሪያ ፕሮግራም ላይ ንግግር ያደረጉት በምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ማዕረግ የአፋር ብሔራዊ ክልላዊ መንግስት የኢኮኖሚክ ክላስተር አስተባባሪ አቶ አሊ ማህመድ ፖሊዮን ከክልላችን ብሎም ከሀገራችን ለማጥፋት በቅንጅትና በቁርጠኝነት መስራት ይጠይቃል ሲሉ ተናግረዋል።

በክልሉ ለተከታታይ አራት ቀናት በሚደረገው የተቀናጀ የፖሊዮ ክትባት ዘመቻ እድሜያቸው ከ 5 ዓመት በታች የሆኑ  ከ364 ሺህ በላይ ህፃናት ይከተባሉ ብለዋል።

ሁለንተናዊ ጤንነታቸው የተረጋጠ ማህበረሰብ መፍጠርም ሆነ እንዲፈጠር መስራት የዛሬው ትውልድ ኃላፊነትና ግዴታ መሆኑን በመገንዘብ ሁሉም ባለድርሻ አካላት ግዴታቸውን መወጣት ይገባል ያሉት አቶ አሊ ማህሙድ የክልሉ መንግስት ለተቀናጀው የፖሊዮ ክትባት ዘመቻ አስፈላጊው ድጋፍ ያደርጋል ብለዋል።

በኢትዮጵያ ብሎም በአፍሪካ በክትባት እጥረት ምክንያት የሚመጣ የፖሊዮ ወረርሽኝ የህብረተሰብ ጤና አደጋ ስጋት ሆኖ ቀጥሏል ያሉት የኢትዮጵያ ህብረተሰብ ጤና ኢንስቲትዩት ዋና ዳይሬክተር ዶ/ር መሳይ ኃይሉ ናቸው።

የህፃናትን የበሽታ የመከላከል አቅም ለማሳደግ ከወረርሽን ምላሽ ክትባት ዘመቻዎች ጋር በማቀናጀት ክትባት ያለፋቸው እና ጀምረው ያቋረጡ ህፃናትን የመለየት እንዲሁም ወደ ክትባት ጣቢያዎች ሄደው እንዲከተቡ የማድረግ ስራዎች  መሰራታቸውን ዶ/ር መሳይ ኃይሉ ተናግረዋል።

የክትባት ዘመቻ በተቀመጡት አለም አቀፍ መለኪያ መስፈርቶች መሰረት ጥራቱን የጠበቀ የክትባት ዘመቻ ይሆን ዘንድ ረዘም ላለ ጊዜ ከክልሎች እንዲሁም ከአጋር አካላት ጋር በመተባበር የቅድመ ዝግጅት ስራዎች ሲሰሩ መቆየቱን ዋና ዳይሬክተሩ ጠቁመዋል።

የተቀናጀ የፖሊዮ ክትባት ዘመቻ በሁለት ዙሮች የሚካሄድ ሲሆን የመጀመሪያው ዙር የክትባት ዘመቻ ከመስከረም 27 እስከ 30/2017 ዓ/ም ድረስ ለተከታታይ አራት ቀናት የሚሰጥ ይሆናል ያሉት የኢትዮጵያ ህብረተሰብ ጤና ኢንስቲትዩት ምክትል ዋና ዳይሬክተር ዶ/ር መልካሙ አብቴ ናቸው።

በመጀመሪያው ዙር የክትባት ዘመቻ ከ5.6 ሚሊዮን በላይ የሚሆኑ እድሜያቸው ከአምስት ዓመት በታች የሆኑ ህፃናት ተደራሽ ይሆናሉ ተብሏል።

የተቀናጀ የፖሊዮ ክትባት ዘመቻ የፖሊዮ ቫይረስ በተከሰተባቸው በአማራ፣ በአፋር፣ በጋምቤላ ክልሎችና በአዲስ አበባ ከተማ አስተዳደር እንዲሁም አጎራባች በሆነው በኦሮሚያ ክልል የሸገር ከተማ አስተዳደር ክትባቱ ይሰጣል ብለዋል ዶ/ር መልካሙ አብቴ።

የፖሊዮ በሽታ ስርጭትን በማስቆም በፖሊዮ ቫይረስ ምክንያት የሚከሰትን የልጅነት ልምሻና ሞትን ከሀገራችን ብሎም ከአህጉራችን አፍሪካ የማጥፋት ግብን ለማሳካት ታልሞ የሚሰጥ በመሆኑ ሁሉም ባለድርሻ አካላት የበኩላቸውን አስተዋጽኦ እንዲወጡ የኢትዮጵያ ህብረተሰብ ጤና ኢንስቲትዩት ምክትል ዋና ዳይሬክተር ዶ/ር መልካሙ አብቴ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል።

የተቀናጀ የፖሊዮ ክትባት ዘመቻ በአፋር ብሔራዊ ክልላዊ መንግሥት በሰመራ ጤና ጣቢያ የተጀመረ ሲሆን በዕለቱም ከጤና ሚኒስቴር፣ ከአፋር ጤና ቢሮ፣ የኢትዮጵያ ህብረተሰብ ጤና ኢንስቲትዩትና ከአጋር ድርጅቶች አመራሮች፣ የስራ ክፍል ኃላፊዎች እና ባለሙያዎች ተገኝተዋል።

text:
አራዳ የሴቶችና የሕፃናት ህክምና ልዩ ማዕከል አገልግሎት ጀመረ። 
_______________

ከ32 ዓመታት በላይ ባበረከተው አገልግሎት ሜሪ ስቶፕስ ኢንተርናሽናል በመባል ይታወቅ የነበረው  የእናቶች ሕፃናትና የስነ ተዋልዶ ማዕከል አገልግሎቱን በማስፋትና በማዘመን አራዳ የሴቶችና ሕፃናት ህክምና ልዩ ማዕከል ኤም ኤስ አይ ኢትዮጵያ በሚል አዲስ ስያሜ ስራ ጀምሯል።  

ጤና መንግሥት ብቻ የሚሰራው አይደለም ያሉት የሕዝብ ተወካዮች ምክር ቤት የጤና ማህበራዊ ልማት ባህልና ስፖርት ጉዳዮች ቋሚ ኮሚቴ ሰብሳቢ ክብርት ወ/ሮ ወርቀሰሙ ማሞ የእናቶች እና የህፃናት ሞትን ለመቀነስ ተቋሙ እየሰራው ለሚገኘው ስራ ኤም ኤስ አይን አመስግነዋል ሌሎችም ተሞክሮውን እንዲያሰፉ መክረዋል።

የጤና ሚኒስትር ዴኤታ ዶክተር አየለ ተሾመ በበኩላቸው ለወጣቶች የጤና አገልግሎት ምቹ ባልነበረበት ወቅት አገልግሎት ይሰጥ እንደነበር በማስታወስ አዳጊ የሆነውን የማህበረሰብ ፍላጎት ለማርካት ጥራትና ተደራሽነቱን እያሰፋ ወረቀት አልባ ስርዓት በመዘርጋት እያደረገ ላለው አስተዋጽኦ አመስግነዋል። የግልና የመንግስት ተቋማትን ቅንጅታዊ አሰራር ለማጠናከር ተቋሙ የሚሰራውን ሥራ ለመደገፍም ቃል ገብተዋል። 

የኤም ኤስ አይ ኢትዮጵያ ዋና ዳይሬክተር ዶክተር አበበ ሽብሩም ተቋሙ ከተመሠረተበት ጊዜ ጀምሮ የመጣበትን መንገድ የእናቶችና ሕፃናት ከሁለት ክልሎች ውጭ በሁሉም የሀገራችን ክፍሎች አገልግሎት እየሰጠ መሆኑንና ጤናን በመጠበቅ ረገድ ያለው ድርሻ ከፍተኛ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።  በመድረኩ አገልግሎት ያገኙ እናቶች ምስክርነታቸውን ሰጥተዋል።

የኢትዮጵያ የጤና ድንገተኛ አደጋና ወረርሽኝ መከላከል፣ ዝግጁነት እና ምላሽ አሰጣጥ አፈጻጸም ላይ ውይይት ተካሄደ
___________

በየሶስት ወሩ የሚካሄደው የጋራ የትብብር ኮሚቴ ስብሰባ የጤና ሚኒስቴር፣ የኢትዮጵያ ህብረተሰብ ጤና ኢንስቲትዩት፣ የአለም ጤና ድርጅት፣ የአለም ምግብ ኦርጋናይዜሽን (ፋኦ)፣ እና የዩኒሴፍ ከፍተኛ አመራሮች በተገኙበት የተካሄደ ሲሆን፤ የኢትዮጵያ የጤና ድንገተኛ አደጋና ወረርሽኝ መከላከል፣ ዝግጁነት እና ምላሽ አሰጣጥ አፈጻጸም ሪፖርት ቀርቦ ውይይት ተደርጎበታል፡፡ 

የኢትዮጵያ የጤና ድንገተኛ አደጋ እና የወረርሽኝ መከላከል፣ ዝግጁነት እና ምላሽ አሰጣጥ አፈጻጸም ተገምግሞ ያጋጠሙ ተግዳሮቶች ተለይቶ የወደፊት አቅጣጫ ተቀምጠዋል፡፡ 

የኢትዮጵያ የጤና ድንገተኛ አደጋና ወረርሽኝ መከላከል፣ ዝግጁነት እና ምላሽ አሰጣጥ አፈጻጸም አበረታች ቢሆንም፤ አሁንም ብዙ መሻሻል የሚገባቸው ጉዳዮ መኖራቸውን የተናገሩት የጤና ሚኒስትር ዶ/ር መቅደስ ዳባ፤ የላብራቶሪ ፣የሰው ሃብት  እና ሌሎች  ቀሪ ስራዎች ላይ ትኩረት በመስጠት በጋራ መስራት ያስፈልጋል ብለዋል።

በወባ መከላከል ስራዎች ላይ የተገኙ መልካም ተሞክሮዎችን ለማበረታታትና ያጋጠሙ ተግዳሮቶችን በጋራ ለመፍታት የሚረዳ ውይይት ከክልል ጤና ቢሮ እና ተጠሪ ተቋማት የስራ ሀላፊዎች ጋር በአዲስ አበባ  እየተካሄደ ነዉ
______________

የውይይት መድረኩ መዘጋጀት የባለፉት ሶስት ወራት በጤናው ዘርፍ የተሠሩ እና በቀጣይ ለመስራት የታቀዱ ስራዎችን ተናቦ ለመስራት እንደሚያስችል የተናገሩት የጤና ሚኒስትር ዶ/ር መቅደስ ዳባ፤ በሁሉም ክልሎች የተሰሩ የወባ መከላከል ስራዎች የመስክ ጉብኝት እና የመጀመሪያ ደረጃ ጤና ክብካቤ አፈጻጸም ላይ የተገኙ መልካም ተሞክሮዎችን ለማስቀጠል እና የሚጠበቀውን ያህል ውጤት ያላስመዘገቡ ተቋማትን ለማገዝና ለማስተካከል የሚረዳ ውይይት ለማድረግ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል፡፡ 

በመድረኩ የወባ መከላከል እና መቆጣጠር እንዲሁም የመጀመሪያ ጤና ክብካቤ ስራዎች ላይ በአገር አቀፍ ደረጃ የተዋቀረው ግብረሃይል በሁሉም ክልሎች ድጋፋዊ ምልከታ በማድረግ ከዚህ አንጻር የተለዩ መልካም ተሞክሮዎችና ያጋጠሙ ችግሮች በጤና ሚኒስትር ደኤታዎች ሪፖርት ቀርቧል፡፡ እንዲሁም በአጠቃላይ የጤናው ዘርፍን ለማሻሻል ከክልል ጤና ቢሮ ሃላፊዎች ጋር ውይይት ተደርጓል፡፡ 

በድጋፋዊ ጉብኝቱ የዋባ በሽታን ለመከላከልና ለመቆጣጠር እየተሰሩ ባሉ የተቀናጀ ስራዎች የህብረተሰቡን ግንዛቤ ከፍ በማድረግ፣ የአጎበር አጠቃቀም፣ የጸረ-ወባ ኬሚካል ርጭትና አጠቃቀም፣ ዉሃ ያቆሩ ቦታዎችን የማፋሳስና ማዳፈን እንዲሁም አስፈላጊዉን ምርመራና ህክምና አገልግሎት አሰጣጥ ላይ እመርታ መምጣቱ በሪፖርቱ ተገልጿል፡፡ 

በአንዳንድ አከባቢዎች አስፈላጊው ግብዓት በወቅቱ በሚፈለገው ደረጃ አለመድረስ፣ የህብረተሰቡ ተሳትፎ ማነስ፣ የጤና ተቋማት ዝግጁነትና ምላሽ አሰጣጥ እና የአጎበር አጠቃቀም ጉድለት የወባ መከላከል ስራ ላይ ያጋጠሙ ተግዳሮቶች መሆናቸውን የተናገሩት የጤና ሚኒስትር ዴኤታ ዶ/ር ደረጀ ዱጉማ፤ ከመስክ ጉብኝት በኋላ የታዩ ችግሮችን ለመቅረፍ በክልሎች ንቅናቄ መልኩ እየተሰራ መሆኑን ባቀረቡት ሪፓርት ገልጸዋል፡፡ 

በጎ ፍቃደኞችን በማሰማራት የማህበረሰብ ተሳትፎን ለማሳደግ መቻሉ መልካም ተሞክሮ መሆኑን የጤና ሚኒስትር ዴኤታ ዶ/ር አየለ ተሾመ  የገለጹ ሲሆን፤ ክልሎች የመጀመሪያ ደረጃ ጤና አገልግሎትን እና የማህበረሰብ ተሳትፎን ማሳደግ እንደሚገባቸው ጠቁመዋል፡፡ 

የማህበረሰብ እና የሃይማኖት መሪዎችን በማስተባበር የማህበረሰብ ንቅናቄን በመፍጠር የወባ መራቢያዎችን በማፋሰስ የወባ መከላከል ስራዎችን በመስራት ውጤት መገኘቱን የተናገሩት ደግሞ የጤና ሚኒስትር ዴኤታ ወ/ሮ ፍሬህይወት አበበ ሲሆኑ፡ በጉባኤው የተቀመጡ የመፍትሄ አቅጣጫዎችን የክልል ጤና ቢሮዎችና የሚመለከታቸው ባለድርሻ አካላት ተግባራዊ እንደሚያደርጉ ያላቸውን እምነት ገልጸዋል፡፡  

በመድረኩ የ2017 በጀት አመት የአምስት ወራት የጤናው ዘርፍ የዋና ዋና ተግባራት አፈጻጸምም ቀርቦ በተሳታፊዎች ውይይት እየተደረገበት ነው፡፡

የሕብረተሰብ የጤና አደጋዎች ከጊዜ ወደ ጊዜ እየተበራከቱና ፈተና እየሆኑ ስለመጡ የጤና ስርዓቱ ይህንን ታሳቢ ያደረገ ዝግጅት ሊኖረው ይገባል፡- የጤና ሚኒስትር ዴኤታ ዶ/ር አየለ ተሾመ
___________

የኢትዮጵያ የሕብረተሰብ ጤና ኢንስቲትዩት10ኛውን የሕብረተሰብ ጤና አደጋዎች ቁጥጥር ፎረም ”የማይበገር የሕብረተሰብ ጤና አደጋዎች ቁጥጥር ስርዓት ለብሄራዊ ጤና ደህንነት” በሚል መሪ ቃል በሃዋሳ ከተማ እያካሄደ ነው፡፡

ጉባኤውን በንግግር የከፈቱት የጤና ሚኒስትር ዴኤታ ዶ/ር አየለ ተሾመ ዛሬ እዚህ የደረስነው እንደሃገር በተለያዩ ጊዜያት ሲፈትኑን የነበሩ ሰው ሰራሽና የተፈጥሮ አደጋዎችን በጋራ ምላሽ በመስጠት ነው፤ ለዚህ ደግሞ በየደረጃው የሚገኙ የጤናው ዘርፍ አመራሮች፣ ባለሙያዎችና ባለድርሻ አካላት የነበራቸው አስተዋጽኦ ከፍተኛ እንደነበር አስታውቀዋል፡፡

ይሁን እንጂ ዓለምን እየፈተኑ ያሉ የህብረተሰብ የጤና አደጋዎች ከጊዜ ወደ ጊዜ እየተበራከቱና እንደ ሃገርም ፈተና እየሆኑ ስለመጡ የጤና ስርዓታችን ይህንን ታሳቢ ያደረገ ዝግጅት ሊኖረው እንደሚገባ ዶ/ር አየለ ገልጸዋል፡፡

የኢትዮጵያ የሕብረተሰብ ጤና ኢንስቲትዩት ዋና ዳይሬክተር ዶ/ር መሳይ ኃይሉ በበኩላቸው ይህ ፎረም ዘርፈ ብዙ የሕብረተሰብ ጤና አደጋዎች ቁጥጥር ተግባራትን በሁሉም መዋቅሮች ውጤታማ እዲሆኑ ለማስረጽ ትልቅ ዕድል የሚፈጠር መድረክ ነው ብለዋል፡፡

መድረኩ የሕብረተሰብ ጤና አደጋዎች ቁጥጥር ስራዎችን የምንገመግምበት፣ የገጠሙንን ችግሮች መንስኤዎች የምንፈትሽበት፣ ቀጣይ አቅጣጫዎች የምናስቀምጥት እንዲሁም አዲስ የተከሰቱና በድጋሜ የሚከሰቱ የሕብረተሰብ የጤና አደጋዎችን ለመከላከል መፍትሄ የምናፈላልግበት መድረክ እንደሆነ ዶ/ር መሳይ ገልጸዋል፡፡

የሕብረተሰብ ጤና አደጋዎች ቁጥጥር ስራን ውጤታማ ከሚያደርጉት ነገሮች መካከል አንዱ በሽታዎች ሳይከሰቱ በፊት የሚከናወኑት የዝግጁነት ተግባራት ናቸው ያሉት ደግሞ የሲዳማ ክልል ጤና ቢሮ ኃላፊ ዶ/ር ሰላማዊት መንገሻ ናቸው፡፡

የሕብረተሰብ ጤና ኢንስቲትዩት ምክትል ዋና ዳይሬክተር ዶ/ር መልካሙ አብቴ በዚህ መድረክ የሕብረተሰባችንን የጤና አደጋ ለመከላከል የሁላችንም ቁርጠኝነት የምናሳይበት መሆኑን ገልጸው ከጊዜ ወደ ጊዜ የጤና አደጋዎች በአይነትና በቁጥር እየተስፋፉ ስለመጡ ፈጣን ምላሽ መስጠት በእጅጉ አስፈላጊ እንደሆነ ተናግረዋል፡፡

የኢትዮጵያ አደጋ ስጋት ኮሚሽነር ክቡር አምባሳደር ዶ/ር ሽፈራው ተ/ማርያም ”የቤተሰብ ኃላፊነትና የማህበረሰብ አጋርነት ለሁሉም አይነት አደጋዎች አይበገሬነት!” የሚል ጽሁፍ ለተሳታፊዎች አቅርበዋል፡፡ 

በሲዳማ ክልል ሃዋሳ ከተማ እየተካሄደ በሚገኘው የሕብረተሰብ ጤና አደጋዎች ቁጥጥር ፎረም ላይ የጤና ሚኒስቴር፣ የኢትዮጵያ ሕብረተሰብ ጤና ኢንስቲትዩት፣ የክልል የጤናው ዘርፍ ከፍተኛ አመራሮችና ባለሙያዎች እንዲሁም የኢትዮጵያ አደጋ ስጋት ኮሚሽንና የፌዴራል ፖሊስ ጤና ዳይሬክቶሬት ከፍተኛ አመራሮች ተገኝተዋል፡፡

***********************

(አዲስ አበባ፣ መስከረም 2/ 2017 ዓ.ም) የሴቶችና ማህበራዊ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር ከእንረዳዳ የአረጋውያን በጎ አድራጎት ማህበር ጋር በመተባበር አዲሱን ዓመት ምክንያት በማድረግ ለአረጋዊያን ማዕድ አጋርተዋል።

በተመሳሳይ ሚኒስቴር መስሪያ ቤቱ ለእንረዳዳ አረጋውያን የበጎ አድራጎት ማህበር የ2 መቶ ሺህ ብር የገንዘብ ድጋፍ አድርጓል።

በመርሃ ግብሩ ላይ የሴቶችና ማህበራዊ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ክብርት ዶክተር ኤርጎጌ ተሰፋዬ አረጋውያን ያካበቱትን እውቀት፣ ልምድና ተሞክሮ ለተተኪው ትውልድ በማስተላለፍ እሴቶቻችን እንዲጠበቁ ብልም ለሀገር ልማትና እድገት የበኩላቸውን አስተዋጽኦ እንደሚያበርከቱ ገልፀዋል፡፡ 

የሀገር ባለውለታ ለሆኑት አረጋውያን ሁሉም ፍቅርና ክብር ሊሰጣቸው ይገባል ብለዋል።

በዕድሜና በሌሎች ተጓዳኝ ምክንያቶች አረጋውያን ለችግር እንዳይጋለጡ አቅም በፈቀደ መጠን ሀሉም ድጋፍና ክብካቤ እንዲያደርግም መልዕክት አስተላልፈዋል። 

ለአረጋውያን ያለን ክብርና ፍቅር ለመግለፅና በዓሉን ተደስተው እንዲያሳልፉ ለማስቻል ማዕድ የማጋራት መርሃ ግብሩ መዘጋጀቱን ጠቁመዋል።

ወደፊትም የተለያዩ አካላትን በማስተባበር ለአረጋውያን የሚያደርገውን ድጋፍ አጠናክሮ ይቀጥላል ብለዋል።

****************
(አዳማ፣ ጥቅምት 20/ 2017 ዓ.ም) የፌዴሬሽን ምክር ቤትና የሴቶችና ማህበራዊ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር በመተባበር ህብረ ብሔራዊ ፌደራላዊ ስርዓት ግንባታው እየገጠሙት ያሉት ተግዳሮቶች እና የመፍትሔ ሐሳቦች ላይ ያተኮረ የአሰልጣኞች ስልጠና መድረክ ተዘጋጅቷል።

በስልጠናው መክፈቻ ላይ ንግግር ያደረጉት የፌዴሬሽን ምክር ቤት ምክትል አፈጉባኤ የተከበሩ ወ/ሮ ዘሃራ ዑመድ፥ ህብረ ብሔራዊ ፌደራላዊ ስርዓት የሰላም መገንቢያ፣ የልማት መሰረት፣ የዴሞክራሲያዊ ስርዓት ዋልታና የአንድነትን መገንቢያ መሣሪያ ነው ብለዋል።

ህብረ ብሔራዊ የፌዴራል ስርዓት እውን መሆን የሴቶች ማህበራዊ፣ ኢኮኖሚያዊና ፖለቲካዊ ተሳትፎና እኩል ተጠቃሚነት ለማረጋገጥ በሚደረገው ጥረት ውስጥ የበኩሉን አስተዋፅዖ ማበርከቱን ገልፀዋል።

የዘንድሮው 19ኛው የኢትዮጵያ ብሔር ብሔረሰቦች ቀን "አገራዊ መግባባት ለብሔራዊ አንድነት" በሚል መሪ ቃል እንደሚከበር ጠቁመዋል። 

የስልጠናው ዋና ዓላማም እንደየአካባቢው ሁኔታ የተፈጠሩ ተግዳሮቶችን ነቅሶ በማውጣት እና በመመካከር በመፍትሔዎቻቸው ዙሪያ የጋራ ግንዛቤ ለመያዝና አገራዊ መግባባት ለመፍጠር ታስቦ የተዘጋጀ መሆኑን ምክትል አፈጉባኤዋ አስምረውበታል።

የሴቶችና ማህበራዊ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር የሴቶችና ህጻናት ዘርፍ ሚኒስትር ዴኤታ ክብርት ሒክማ ከይረዲን በበኩላቸው አለም አቀፍ የነጭ ሪቫን ቀን መከበር "ለስርዓተ ፆታ እኩልነት የወንዶች ሚና /አጋርነት/" አስፈላጊ መሆኑን የሚያመላክት ወሳኝ ኩነት መሆኑን ገልፀዋል።

እንዲሁም "ህጻናት የሚሉት አላቸው እናድምጣቸው" በሚል መሪ ቃል የዘንድሮ ዓለም አቀፍ የህጻናት ቀን እንደሚከበር ገልፀው የህጻናትን ጥያቄ ማድመጥና ተገቢ ምላሽ መስጠት አስፈላጊ መሆኑን ተናግረዋል።

ሀገራዊና ዓለም አቀፍ ኩነቱን ምክንያት በማድረግ በሚካሄዱ ሰፋፊ የንቅናቄ ስራዎች የሴቶችንና ህፃናትን ተሳትፎና ተጠቃሚነት ለማሳደግ መታቀዱን ጠቁመው ለጋራ ዕቅዱ መሳካት ሁሉም የሴቶችና የህፃናት አደረጃጀት መዋቅሮች በትብብርና በቅንጅት እንዲሰሩ ክብርት ሚኒስትር ዴኤታዋ መልዕክት አስተላልፈዋል።

ኢትዮጵያና ቺሊ ሴቶችና፣ ወጣቶች በፖለቲካና በዲፕሎማሲ ዘርፍ ላይ ያላቸውን ተሳትፎ ማጠናከር በሚቻልባቸው ሁኔታዎች ላይ  በትብብር ለመስራት ተስማሙ።

*********
(ጥቅምት 29/2017) ኢትዮጵያና ቺሊ በሴቶች፣ ወጣቶችና ሌሎች ማህበራዊ ጉዳዮች ላይ በትብብር ለመስራት ተስማሙ።

የሴቶችና ማህበራዊ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ኤርጎጌ ተስፋዬ(ዶ/ር) እና የሚኒስቴር መስሪያቤቱ ከፍተኛ አመራሮች ጋር  በቺሊ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ዴኤታ ግላሪያ ዴ ላ ፎንቴ ከተመራ ልዑክ ጋር ተወያይተዋል።

ኤርጎጌ ተስፋዬ (ዶ/ር)  በውይይቱ ባደረጉት ንግግር ኢትዮጵያ የስርአተ ፆታ- እኩልነትን ለማረጋገጥ፣ በተለይም ቺሊ የሴቶችን ተሳትፎ ያረጋገጠ የፓለቲካ ተሳትፎና ሴቶችና ወጣቶችን በይበልጥ የሚያበረታታ የዲፕሎማሲ ስትራቴጂን በመጠቀም የሰራችውን ስራ ወደ ኢትዮጵያ ማምጣት እንደሚፈልጉ ገልፀዋል።

ሚኒስትሯ አክለውም ኢትዮጵያ የወጣቶችንና ለችግር ተጋላጭ የሆኑ የህብረተሰብ ክፍሎችን አቅም ለማሳደግ የ10 ዓመት ስትራቴጂክ ዕቅድ በመንደፍ እየተገበረች መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።

ከቺሊ ጋር በዘርፉ ያለንን ግንኙነት ማጠናከራችን በስትራቴጂክ ዕቅዱ የተመላከቱ ተግባራትን በመላ ሀገሪቱ ተደራሽ ለማድረግ ያግዛል ብለዋል፡፡

በተጨማሪም በተለይም የሴቶችን፣ የወጣቶችንና ተጋላጭ የሆኑ የማህበረሰብ ክፍሎችን አቅም በማጎልበት የስርአተ -ፆታ እኩልነትንና አካታችነትን ውጤታማ እንደሚያደርግ ያላቸውን እምነት ገልጸዋል።

የቺሊ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ዴኤታ ግላሪያ ዴ ላፎንቴ በበኩላቸው የቺሊ እና ኢትዮጵያ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነት በርካታ አመታት ማስቆጠሩን ተናግረዋል።

አክለውም ቺሊ ሴቶች ላይ ልዩ ትኩረት ያደረገ የውጭ ጉዳይ ፖሊሲ እንዳላት ጠቅሰው ይህንንም ልምድ እስከአሁን እንደ ካናዳ ላሉ አገራት ማጋራታቸውን ጠቁመው በቀጣይም  በእነዚህና ሌሎች መስኮች ላይ የመግባቢያ ስምምነቶችን በመፈራረም ወደስራ ለመግባት የቺሊ መንግስት ዝግጁ መሆኑን ጠቅሰዋል።

ውይይቱ ሁለቱ ሀገራት በሴቶች ወጣቶችና ለችግር ተጋላጭ የሆኑ የማህበረሰብ ክፍሎችን በመደገፍና በማብቃት ረገድ ያላቸውን ግንኙነት ማጠናከር በሚችሉበት ሁኔታ ላይ ያተኮረ ነው።

*******
ስለ ሴቶችና ማሕበራዊ ጉዳዮች ሚኒስቴር ተጨማሪ መረጃዎችን ለማግኘት ከታች ያሉ ገፆቻችንን ይጎብኙ

*********************

(ታህሳስ 10/2017 ዓ.ም ) በኢፌዴሪ የሴቶችና ማህበራዊ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ክብርት ዶክተር ኤርጎጌ ተስፋዬ ሲመራ የነበረው የፌዴራልና የክልሉ ከፍተኛ አመራሮች በሶስቱ ዞኖች ሲያካሂድ የነበረው የመስክ ምልከታ የማጠቃለያ መርሐ ግብር ተከናውኗል።

ክብርት ሚኒስትር ዶክተር ኤርጎጌ ተስፋዬ በዚሁ ጊዜ እንዳሉት፥ ክልሉ ሰፊ የመልማት አቅም ያለውና በአጭር ጊዜ ውስጥም ሊለወጥ የሚችል አካባቢ መሆኑን በነበራቸው የመስክ ምልከታ እንዳረጋገጡ ተናግረዋል።

በመሆኑም በክልሉ ያለውን ሰፊ የተፈጥሮ ሃብት ወደ ልማት በመለወጥ የታለመውን የልማት ግብ ዕውን ለማድረግ በትብብር ጠንክሮ መስራት ይገባል ብለዋል።

በክልሉ ያለውን የተፈጥሮ ሃብት በአግባቡ ማልማት ከተቻለ ለአካባቢው ማህበረሰብ ብቻ ሳይሆን ለአገር የሚተርፍ ሃብት እንዳለ በነበራቸው ቆይታ መረዳታቸውን ገልፀዋል።

እንደ ፌዴራል መንግስትም በክልሉ የተጀመሩ የድጋፍና የክትትል ስራዎች ተጠናክረው እንደሚቀጥሉ ሚኒስትሯ አብራርተዋል።

የክልሉ ርዕሰ መስተዳድር ክብርት ወይዘሮ አለሚቱ ኡሞድ በበኩላቸዉ በክልሉ ሰፊ የተፈጥሮ ሃብት ቢኖርም ባለፉት አመታት በተፈለገው ልክ ማልማት ባለመቻሉ ህዝቡ ተጠቃሚ ሳይሆን መቆየቱን ተናግረዋል።

ከለውጡ ማግስት ጀምሮ በክልሉ እኩል የመልማት አቅም ለመፍጠር እየተሰሩ ባሉት ስራዎች አበረታች ወጤቶች እየተመዘገቡ እንደሚገኙ ገልፀዋል።

ወደ ክልሉ የመጡት ክብርት ሚኒስትሯ በተለያዩ የልማት ዘርፎች የክትትልና የድጋፍ ስራዎችን ሲያከናውን መቆየቱን ተናግረዋል ሲል የጋምቤላ ክልል የመንግስት ኮሙኒኬሽን ጉዳዮች ጽህፈት ቤት ዘግቧል።

(አዲስ አበባ፣ ጥር 8/2017 ዓ.ም) በጎዳና የሚገኙ ወገኖችን ለማንሣት እንደ ሀገር እስካሁን በተከናወነው ሥራ የተነሺዎች ቁጥር ከነበረበት 62ሺህ125 ወደ 86ሺህ 500 ከፍ ማለቱን የሴቶችና ማኅበራዊ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር አስታወቀ፡፡

በተጠናቀቀው ግማሽ ዓመትም 24ሺህ 377 ወገኖችን ከጎዳ በማንሳት የማቋቋም ሥራ መከናወኑን ነው ሚኒስትር ዴኤታዋ ሁሪያ አሊ የተናገሩት፡፡

ባለፉት ሥድስት ወራት ከክልሎችና ከፌዴራል ከተማ አሥተዳደሮች በተገኘ በጀት 908 ህፃናት፣ 22 ሺህ 908 ወንድ እና 561 ሴት በድምሩ 24ሺህ 377 ወገኖችን ከጎዳና ላይ በማንሳት የተቋም አገልግሎት እንዲያገኙ፣ ወደ መጡበት አካባቢና ቤተሰቦቻቸው ተመልሰው እንዲቋቋሙ መደረጉን ገልጸዋል፡፡

ይህን ተከትሎም ከጎዳና ላይ የተነሱ፣ በአገልግሎት መስጫ ተቋማት የተለያዩ አገልግሎቶችን ያገኙ እና ወደ ቤተሰቦቻቸውና ማሕበረሰቡ የተቀላቀሉ፣ የተዋሃዱና የተቋቋሙ ወገኖችን ቁጥር ከነበረበት ወደ 74ሺህ 082 ከፍ ለማድረግ ታቅዶ 86ሺህ 500 ማድረስ ተችሏል ብለዋል፡፡

በዚህ ረገድ ያለው አፈፃፀምም 116.7 በመቶ መሆኑን ጠቅሰው ትኩረት ተሰጥቶ ከሚመለከታቸው ባለድርሻ አካላት ጋር በቅንጅት በመሥራቱ ዕቅዱን ከታሰበው በላይ ማሳካት ተችሏል ነው ያሉት፡፡

ሆኖም በተፈጥሮና ሰው ሰራሽ አደጋ ከጎዳና የሚነሱ ዜጎች ብዛት እንደ ሀገር ካሉት የጊዜያዊ መጠለያ ማገገሚያ ጋር የሚመጣጠን አለመሆኑ ለስራው ተግዳሮት መፍጠሩን አንስተዋል፡፡

የበጀት ውሱንነት መኖሩ እንዲሁም በተሳሳተ አመለካከትና በተለያዩ ምክንያቶች ወደ ከተሞች የሚደረግ ፍልሰት አሁንም ያለመቆሙ ሌላው ተጠቃሽ ችግር መሆኑን ሚኒስትር ዴኤታዋ ተናግረዋል። 

ችግሩን በዘላቂነት ለመፍታትና ዜጎችም የተሻለ የማህበራዊ ጥበቃ አገልግሎት ተጠቃሚ እንዲሆኑ  ተጨማሪ ሀብት ከማሰባሰብ ጎን ለጎን የአመለካከት ለውጥ ለማምጣት የሚረዳ የግንዛቤና ንቅናቄ ስራዎችን መስራት እንዲሁም ቅንጅታዊ አሰራሩን የበለጠ ማጠናከር ይገባል ብለዋል።

ይህ የከበረ የቤተሰብ ተቋም በሃገራችን ከምስረታው ጀምሮ ከፍ ያለ ከበሬታ የሚሰጠው ሲሆን እንደየባህሉ በልዩ ልዩ ዝግጅት፣ በሰርግ እና በምርቃት ታጅቦ፣ በህብረተሰቡም እውቅና ተሰጥቶት፤ በአንዲት ሴት እና ወንድ መካከል በሙሉ ፈቃደኝነት በሚመሰረት ጋብቻ የሚጸና ዘላቂ ጥምረት እና ተቋም ነው፡፡ ትዳር የመሰረተ ሰው በህብረተሰቡ የሚኖረው ከበሬታ እና የሚሰጠው ሥፍራ ከፍ ያለ ነው፡፡ ማህበራዊ ተሳትፎው እና ኃላፊነቱም በዛው ልክ ያድጋል፡፡ ባለትዳሮች እርስ በርሳቸው ይረዳዳሉ፣ ትውልድም ያስቀጥላሉ፡፡

ህይወቱን በጋብቻ የሚጀምረው ቤተሰብ በልኩ የተሰፋ የታወቀ ሚና እና ከፍ ያለ ኃላፊነት አለበት፡፡ በዚህ ሂደት ውስጥ ደህንነቱን የሚፈትኑ ነገሮች ከየአቅጣጫው ሊመጡ ይችላሉ፡፡ በዚህ ጊዜ በጋብቻ የፀኑትን በማሰብ፣ ልምዳቸውን በመጋራት፣ የህይወት ተሞክሯቸውን በመቅሰም፣ በመነጋገር እና በመደማመጥ ነገሩን ጊዜ ሰጥቶ በማቆየት ትዕግስትን እና ማስተዋልን በማስቀደም በስክነት እና በእርጋታ የትዳር ውስጥ ፈተናዎችን መቋቋም ይቻላል፡፡ ይህ ከጥንዶቹ ከውስጣቸው የሚመነጭ በጓዳቸው የሚዘጋጅ መፍትሔ ነው፡፡ 

ከፍ ብሎ ነገሩ ከጠነከረ ጉዳዩን በቤተዘመድ በማየት፣ በቅርብ ሰዎች እና በታላላቆች ተሳትፎ በመወያየት አላፊውን ፈታኝ ሁኔታ ሳይሆን መጪውን የቤተሰብ እጣ ፈንታ በማሰብ ለራስም ለልጆችም ደህንነት እና ጤናማ ህይወት መቀጠል ትዳርን ከመፍታት ችግሩን መፍታት እጅግ የተሻለ አማራጭ ነው፡፡

(ሚያዝያ 2/2017)የሴቶችና ማህበራዊ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር ሚኒስትር -ኤርጎጌ ተስፋዬ (ዶ/ር) “ሰላምን ተለማመዱ በሰላም ኑሩ” የሚል  ፕሮጀክት ይፋዊ ማስጀመሪያ ላይ እንደተናገሩት ሚኒስቴር መ/ቤቱ የሴቶችን የወጣቶች እና ተጋላጭ የማህበረሰብ ክፍሎች የሰላም ግንባታ ሂደቶች ላይ ከመካተታቸው በዘለል ዋና አካልና የአመራር ሚና እንዲኖራቸው እየሠራ እንደሚገኝ ጠቅሰዋል።

ሚኒስትር መስሪያ ቤቱ ካሉት መጠነ ሰፊ ሃላፊነቶች መካከል አንዱ ማህበራዊ ትስስርን ማጠናከር እና ይህ ትስስር እንዳይጎለብት የሚያደርጉ እንደ ድህነት፣ ግጭት፣ መገለል፣ የእኩልነት አለመኖር እና የአካታች ተሳትፎ እጥረቶችን ለመቅረፍ የድርሻውን እየተወጣ እንደሚገኝ ገልጸዋል።

እውነተኛ ሰላም ዘላቂ ሊሆን የሚችለው ሁሉም ድምጾች የሚሰሙበት፣ ሁሉም ተሞክሮዎች የሚከበሩበት እና ሁሉም የማህበረሰብ አካላት አስተዋፀኦ ለማድረግ ህጻናት፣ ሴቶች፡ ወጣቶች እና ተጋላጭ የማህበረስብን ክፍሎችን ያካተተ ጠንካራ አገራዊ ሰላምን የመገንባት ስራን በምንሰራበት ወቅት መሆኑ የፕሮጄክቱ ወደ ተግባር መግባት ተጨማሪ አቅም እንደሚፈጥር  አስታውቀዋል።

ፕሮጀክቱ በኤስኦሴስ የህጻናት መንደር፣ ጀርመን የአለም ስነ ህዝብ ፋውንዴሽንና ፒ ኤች ኢ ኢትዮጵያ ጥምረት በአፋር፣ ኦሮሚያና ሶማሊ ክልሎች ለ 3 ዓመት የሚተገበር ሲሆን የገንዘብ ድጋፉ ያደረገው  የአውሮፓ ህብረት ነው።

Marhai Forest Reserve Becomes a National Park

The Nasarawa State Government has officially handed over the Marhai Forest Reserve to the Federal Government, marking a milestone in biodiversity conservation.

At the handover in Lafia, the Minister of Federal Ministry of Environment Balarabe Abbas Lawal, commended Governor Abdullahi Sule and the people of Nasarawa for their environmental commitment. He highlighted the ecological and economic importance of the reserve, home to diverse wildlife and the iconic Farin Ruwa Waterfalls, with potential to boost ecotourism and local livelihoods.

The Federal Government plans to ensure community involvement, enhance ranger security, and partner with local and international stakeholders to manage the park sustainably.

This collaboration sets a precedent for environmental stewardship in Nigeria, preserving natural heritage for future generations.

Last night, my husband, His Excellency Dr. Julius Maada Bio, and I had the distinct honor of hosting a welcoming dinner for His Excellency Joseph Boakai Sr., the President of Liberia, at the presidential lodge in Freetown. This event represented a significant step towards strengthening the bilateral relationship between Sierra Leone and Liberia, two neighboring countries with shared histories and aspirations.

As the evening progressed, guests enjoyed a sumptuous meal featuring traditional dishes from both Sierra Leonean and Liberian cuisines. The culinary experience served as a metaphor for unity, celebrating diversity while fostering camaraderie among attendees.

Today, I joined Major General Amara Idara Bangura, the Chief of Defence Staff (CDS) of the RSLAF, to inspect the historic Signal Hill area. This site holds great significance in Sierra Leone’s history and reflects the sacrifices that shaped our nation.

During the 1997 conflict between the AFRC and ECOMOG, Signal Hill was the site of a devastating bombing. Standing there today, I was reminded of our nation’s resilience and the progress we’ve made towards peace.

FMB.

As we step into the new year, it is with great hope and resilience that I, on behalf of Sierra Leonean women and girls, extend my heartfelt wishes to all peace-loving Sierra Leoneans both at home and abroad. Last year, 2024, presented numerous challenges; however, through unity and perseverance, we stood firm and overcame these obstacles together.

Let us embrace one another in solidarity as we support President Bio’s Big Five Agenda. This initiative aims to transform our nation by improving critical sectors such as food security, energy access, quality education, healthcare services, and transportation infrastructure for the benefit of everyone.

May God bless us all abundantly in this new year. Together, let us strive for a prosperous 2025!

FMB.

Kick-off of the construction of a National Arts Centre to develop the creative industries

An official ceremony to mark the commencement of the design and construction of the National Arts Centre, was held, yesterday evening, at Réunion Maurel in Petit Raffray. 

The project, with an estimated cost of Rs 100 million, will unfold in two phases: the first phase, to the tune of some Rs 50 million, will feature a hall with acoustics and multi-purpose facilities, while the second phase will include an open-air amphitheatre.

The Minister of Arts and Cultural Heritage, Mr Avinash Teeluck, the Minister of Public Service, Administrative and Institutional Reforms, Dr Anjiv Ramdhany, the Parliamentary Private Secretary, Mr Soobeersingh Dhunnoo, and other personalities were in attendance. 

In his address, Minister Teeluck expressed pride in the commencement of the long-anticipated project, highlighting that the National Arts Centre will serve as a hub for diverse activities for all residents. He emphasised that the centre will not only facilitate gatherings for people from different regions but also provide valuable services in art, culture, and training. Mr Teeluck further assured that the centre will be equipped with various features, including a stage and advanced acoustics, to enhance its functionality.

Moreover, Minister Teeluck noted that the project exemplifies Government’s commitment to infrastructural development, aiming to enrich the community with its amenities. He, thus, projected the completion of the National Arts Centre within eight months and urged the residents to foster harmony and respect, underscoring that the strength of Mauritius lies in its diverse population

For his part, Minister Ramdhany spoke about Government’s commitment to overall development across various fields, with a focus on enhancing facilities in villages to benefit all residents. He also underscored the importance of social unity and harmony, affirming that Government’s initiatives are aimed at serving the interests of the population.

As for PPS Dhunno, he outlined Government’s vision to drive economic and infrastructural progress across Mauritius. He stressed that, despite the challenges posed by the COVID-19 pandemic, considerable advancements have been made for the welfare of the population.

Prime Minister Jugnauth attends 100th birthday celebrations of Mrs Tannajee

Mrs Gangabye Tannajee born Sonea, also known as Ajee Gangabye, celebrated her 100th birthday, yesterday at the Dagotière Multipurpose Complex, surrounded by family members and friends. The Prime Minister, Mr Pravind Kumar Jugnauth, was present for the centenarian celebrations.

The Minister of Information Technology, Communication and Innovation, Mr Darsanand Balgobin; the Chairperson of the District Council of Moka, Mr Sudhirchandra Mahesh Kumar Soonarane; and the Chairperson of the Senior Citizens Council, Mr Hanslall Seebaruth, were also present.

An official ceremony was thus organised by the Ministry of Social Integration, Social Security and National Solidarity to honour the new centenarian. On this occasion, she received, from the authorities, a cheque amounting to Rs 26,203; another one to the tune of Rs 10,000 from the National Solidarity Fund; a microwave oven; a bouquet; a centenarian medal; a gift in kind from the Senior Citizens Council; a Special Telephone Service from Mauritius Telecom; and a certificate.

In his address, Prime Minister Jugnauth conveyed his warmest wishes to Mrs Tannajee while lauding her family for the support and care they bestow upon the centenarian. He reaffirmed Government’s commitment in providing robust support to the elderly in a bid to ensure that they enjoy the best possible standard of living. On this score, he pointed out that the authorities are providing a number of facilities and healthcare services for the benefit of the elderly.

He also highlighted the contributions of the elderly in the society who, he acknowledged, have played pivotal roles in securing our lives. He, moreover, stressed the crucial role of children in offering continuous aid and support in the elderly’s lives.

Life History of Mrs Tannajee

Mrs Tannajee was born on 28 October 1924 at Sans Souci. Her parents were labourers. The centenarian had two brothers and two sisters. All of them have passed away. She never went to school and worked as a labourer in vegetable fields and tea cultivations. She religiously married Mr Goind Tannajee, a tailor, in 1949 followed by civil marriage on 14 November 1961. He passed away on 03 July 1991.

The couple was blessed with six children, one son and five daughters. The son and one daughter have passed away. The centenarian has 17 grandchildren, 19 great-grandchildren and three great-great-grandchildren.

Mrs Tannajee likes to eat ‘Bouillon Brede’, ‘Chatini pomme d’amour’ and ‘Bersan’ (a typical Marathi dish). Her hobby is sewing clothes for herself and her children.

As regards her health conditions, the centenarian suffers from high blood pressure and cannot walk by herself.

Mrs Tannajee attributes her long life to the good care provided by her family members.

Foundational Programme in Literacy, Numeracy and Skills to be implemented as from 2025, announces Minister Gungapersad

The Foundation Programme in Literacy, Numeracy and Skills (FPLNS) will be implemented as from resumption of classes in 2025 in a bid to revamp and modernise the education sector.

The Minister of Education and Human Resource, Dr Mahend Gungapersad, made this announcement, yesterday, during a press conference at the seat of his Ministry in Phoenix. High Officials of the Ministry of Education and Human Resource as well as other stakeholders were also present during the press conference.

The Minister highlighted that this 3-year programme is set to replace the Extended Programme. Its goal, he observed, is to open the doors of opportunities for students who have been previously unsuccessful by elevating their self-esteem and self-confidence through an adapted programme that meets their profiles and answers to their aspirations. This programme, he pointed out, will also enable students to develop the essential life skills to evolve in a constantly changing environment; cultivate values that reflect responsible citizenship; and be well-adjusted socially and culturally.

According to Dr Gungapersad, the FPLNS comprises five key features, which are: a competency-based curriculum; a thematic approach; a continuous assessment; components of technical and occupational skills; and a flexible curriculum. This flexible curriculum, he underlined, is organised around three clusters: functional literacy and numeracy; life skills and values; and trade and livelihood skills.

Furthermore, Minister Gungapersad indicated that, upon completion of the FPLNS, every child will exit the programme with an attainment certificate, which is recognised by the Mauritius Qualifications Authority, and may join the Mauritius Institute of Training and Development (MITD). 

The Education Minister also reassured that transitional arrangements have already been made. As such, students who are currently in the Extended Programme will shift to the Foundation Programme for Literacy, Numeracy and Skills, and those who will be in the final year of the Extended Programme (Grade 9+) in 2025 will be given the option to either join the MITD or to sit for the National Certificate of Education examinations at the school where they are posted, he stated.

Moreover, Dr Gungapersad affirmed that a first assessment regarding the implementation of the FPLNS will be carried out after the first trimester and shortcomings, if any, will be addressed accordingly. These can also be discussed during the Assises de l’Education which will be held in April 2025, he added.

Circular Economy: Exploring Trade Policy solutions for Lithium-Ion Battery Waste Management

A one-day workshop on Circular Economy and the Role of Trade Policy in Mauritius for Lithium-Ion Battery Waste opened, today at the Labourdonnais Waterfront Hotel in Port Louis, in the presence of Minister of Foreign Affairs, Regional Integration and International Trade, Mr Dhananjay Ramful.

The event is part of the Climate Competitiveness project, funded by the European Union (EU), in partnership with the International Trade Centre (ITC), and the Government of Mauritius. The Ambassador of the EU to the Republic of Mauritius, Mr Oskar Benedikt; the Senior Advisor of the Trade and Environment Department of the ITC, Mr Alexander Kasterine; and other personalities were also present.

The workshop aims to discuss ITC's findings on how trade policy can aid lithium-ion battery waste management and strengthen the circular economy in Mauritius. It will serve as a platform for industry and Government representatives to identify actions and discuss leveraging trade policies to implement the
Circular Economy Action Plan.

In his opening address, the Minister said that the workshop is a significant step forward, with the ITC presenting findings on how trade policy can assist in medium-term battery waste management. He pointed out that integrating circular economy principles into trade and environmental strategies is key to achieving a sustainable future.

On that score, Mr Ramful announced that Mauritius, with the assistance of the United Nations Environment Programme, has developed a roadmap for a circular economy (2023-2033). He also highlighted the country's involvement in the EU-funded Climate Competitiveness Project, in collaboration
with the ITC, to explore how trade policies can help tackle climate challenges, including lithium-ion battery waste.

The Minister underlined the need to manage lithium-ion battery waste as Mauritius adopts renewable energy and electric mobility, referring to environmental risks and opportunities for recycling. He noted the growing demand for electric vehicle batteries and the potential for second-life applications as millions of batteries reach the end of their life cycle by 2027.

Minister Ramful praised Africa's efforts to expand recycling capabilities but acknowledged the challenges in developing effective waste management systems. 

According to him, regional collaboration could play a key role in overcoming the challenges Mauritius faces in achieving economies of scale for battery recycling, particularly given its position as a Small Island Developing State.

He also outlined trade-related issues, such as the classification of end-of-life batteries as hazardous waste, and reaffirmed Government's commitment to supporting research, innovation, and sustainable
recycling infrastructure through public-private partnerships and regional cooperation.

For his part, the EU Ambassador stressed the importance of developing a strategy for recycling and trading lithium-ion batteries in Mauritius, emphasising that batteries are vital for the clean energy transition. He pointed out that the growing demand for batteries leads to higher demand for raw materials, which involves significant environmental and societal costs, making effective recycling crucial.

Mr Benedikt proposed that regional collaboration, particularly through the EU's trade agreements and the Indian Ocean Commission, could help Mauritius address challenges in battery recycling. He also indicated that the EU is strongly supporting circular economy efforts, including financing the Circular Economy Roadmap for Mauritius and working to improve regulatory frameworks and circularity in the construction
industry.

As for Mr Kasterine, he put forward the role of trade policy in strengthening climate resilience, improving environmental quality, and exploring green market opportunities. He recalled that the project on managing
electric vehicle battery waste supports Mauritius' climate goals. He added that the 10-year electric vehicle integration roadmap, aiming to advance the country's Circular Economy Action Plan by exploring how trade
policy can enhance regional and international cooperation.

National Budget 2025-2026: PM Ramgoolam launches Budget Consultations

This Government aspires to usher in a new socioeconomic paradigm anchored in the principles of meritocracy, efficient economy and social justice, which is underpinned by the resolve of extending support to the most vulnerable and providing equal opportunity for all.

The Prime Minister, Minister of Defence, Home Affairs and External Communications, Minister of Finance, and Minister for Rodrigues and Outer Islands, Dr Navinchandra Ramgoolam, made this statement this afternoon as he launched the Budget 2025-26 consultations, at the Sir Harilall Vaghjee Hall, in Port-Louis.

The Junior Minister of Finance, Mr Dhaneshwar Damry and other eminent personalities were also present on the occasion.

All stakeholders, including representatives of Business and Trade Associations, Professional Bodies, Trade Unions, Non-Governmental Organisations and Civil Society Organisations were convened for the launching ceremony. 

In his address, Prime Minister Ramgoolam underlined that it is crucial for all stakeholders present to fully grasp and take into account of the prevailing economic situation ahead of the budgetary consultations.  

‘We have inherited a dire and unsustainable economic situation, with a total Government debt of Rs 644 billion reaching nearly 90% of the country’s GDP’, deplored the State Leader.  

Furthermore, the Prime Minister highlighted that the country faces the imminent risk of an eventual lowering of its Moody’s ratings, which he warned would have had significant negative on investments and other ripple effects. He however reassured that Moody’s has agreed for Mauritius to retain its ratings upon the negotiations of a dedicated team to undertake the necessary rigorous measures to improve the situation, adding that the country is still under Moody’s surveillance.

Reiterating Government’s prime aim, that is to fix and reconstruct the socioeconomic situation of the country, the Prime Minister emphasised the urgency to act against this unprecedented situation so that the future generation do not have to bear its consequences. 

On that score, Dr Ramgoolam announced the reintroduction of performance-based budgeting for each Ministry, which he stated will ensure that they all become accountable, and reassured that his Office will effect a close monitoring.

PM Ramgoolam urged for the cooperation of all stakeholders during the Budget Consultations and made an appeal for all related activities to be held in discipline. 

Besides, aligned with the overarching objectives of reconstructing the economy and restoring good governance, Prime Minister Ramgoolam listed his key priorities. These include: roll out corrective actions and measures against any misuse of Government funds; eliminate red tape in the public sector; and boost profit-making and income-generating sectors such as tourism and export.

يذكرنا اليوم العالمي للغة العربية بجمال هذه اللغة وعمقها الحضاري، وبأهميتها التاريخية، ودورها في إثراء المعارف بحكم نشأتها في قلب الحضارات، تعاقبت عليها حقبٌ تاريخية رسّخت مكانتها كلغةٍ للعلم والأدب والفن.

كما نشيد بالدور الريادي الذي يلعبه مثقفو اللغة العربية في التنمية الاقتصادية والاجتماعية والثقافية في الدولة، ونحيي الجهود التي تبذلها شتى مؤسسات الرقي بهذه اللغة في تشاد، ودورها في تعزيز مكانة اللغة العربية وتقوية الروح الوطنية والتعايش السلمي بين مختلف مكونات المجتمع التشادي.

Suite à la proclamation par le Conseil Constitutionnel des résultats définitifs des élections législatives et locales du 29 décembre 2024, je tiens à exprimer ma profonde gratitude et mon immense fierté.

Je rends d’abord et avant tout, grâce à Dieu, le Tout Puissant qui nous a permis de franchir les étapes clés du processus électoral. 

Ces élections incarnent la vitalité de notre démocratie, marquent le début de l’ancrage de la décentralisation et reflètent l’engagement qui nous anime collectivement pour bâtir un Tchad plus uni, plus stable, plus démocratique et plus prospère. 

J’adresse mes vives félicitations aux nouveaux élus de tous les bords politiques. Votre victoire illustre non seulement votre dévouement mais aussi la confiance du peuple tchadien à votre égard et surtout à l’égard des idéaux que vous portez.

Pour ceux d’entre vous qui ont participé à cette compétition mais qui n’ont pas pu avoir les voix nécessaires pour décrocher un siège, je salue votre esprit de fair-play et vous exhorte à redoubler d’effort dans votre quête de servir notre nation. 

Chaque effort compte dans la construction de ce Tchad dont nous rêvons tous. Les défis à venir exigent que nous soyons unis et que nos énergies soient fédérées pour offrir à nos compatriotes plus d’espoir et de progrès.

Aux institutions en charge des élections, notamment l’ANGE, le Conseil constitutionnel et la Cour suprême, je tiens à exprimer ma fierté pour le travail accompli en toute indépendance et avec professionnalisme. Vous avez été au cœur d’un processus électoral transparent et crédible, contribuant ainsi à renforcer la confiance de nos concitoyens dans nos institutions démocratiques.

Aux partis politiques, qu’ils aient participé ou choisi de boycotter le scrutin, je tends une main fraternelle. Le Tchad de demain se bâtira dans l’inclusion, le dialogue et par une vision commune au service de notre peuple. La diversité de nos opinions doit donc être une force, et non une faiblesse.

Aux partenaires techniques et financiers, aux observateurs nationaux et internationaux, j’exprime ma gratitude pour la confiance que vous avez placé en ce processus en nous accompagnant à travers  vos soutiens multiformes.

Aux forces de défense et de sécurité, je salue l’abnégation dont vous avez fait montre pour sécuriser le processus électoral jusqu’à son achèvement.

Nous avons surmonté les obstacles qui se sont dressés devant nous pour parvenir à parachever cette transition en mettant en place, les unes après les autres, les institutions consacrées par la Constitution de la 5ème République.

Nous sommes sur le point de tourner définitivement la page de la transition pour nous orienter résolument vers le développement de notre chère patrie. 

Profitant de cet élan que nous demandons aux structures en charge de l’organisation des élections, de prendre les dispositions nécessaires pour l’organisation des élections sénatoriales au cours du premier trimestre de l’année 2025.

L’avenir est devant nous. A nous de le construire avec force et foi. Ensemble, en consolidant notre unité et en mobilisant nos énergies, nous continuerons à écrire les pages glorieuses de l’histoire de notre beau et grand pays.

Vive le Tchad !
Que Dieu vous bénisse.
Je vous remercie.

En cette Journée Internationale des Droits des Femmes, je rends un vibrant hommage aux braves femmes tchadiennes, rurales et urbaines qui, par leur détermination et leur engagement contribuent efficacement à l’édification d’une nation tchadienne résiliante et prospère.

I was delighted to grace the important conference that marks the end of our project on women's political participation and leadership. The goal of women's political participation and leadership is beyond just representation; it is building a just and equitable society where diverse, particularly marginalised voices can contribute to shaping the future.

We celebrate the project's accomplishments and positive impact on women and communities. The project has been a driving force in advancing women's political participation, resulting in a significant increase in women's representation at the local level—an extraordinary achievement for The Gambia. It has empowered more women to run in local government elections, increasing women's representation within community structures.
 
In addition, the project has played a pivotal role in strengthening legal frameworks, policies, gender strategies, and political party bylaws to enhance women's political participation and leadership. This progress is evident in the growing engagement of women, men, youth champions, and advocacy groups pushing for supportive legal reforms.
 
The project has successfully engaged with traditional and religious leaders, men and boys, and women champions, raising awareness about the importance of women's leadership and challenging harmful cultural norms. Furthermore, the project has established a consortium of women who regularly convene to share information and insights through two key initiatives.

While the project officially concludes, its legacy will live on through the women it has empowered, the structures it has built, and the positive changes it has catalysed. The journey towards gender equality in political leadership is ongoing, and the WPL project has laid a strong foundation for continued progress. I wish to appeal to the UN agencies and the peacebuilding fund to ensure we maintain this momentum as we journey toward 2026, that this effort is sustained, and that more women are prepared to come out and be elected to political office.

PRESIDENT AKUFO-ADDO COMMISSIONS THREE MORE DISTRICT HOSPITALS ACROSS THE EASTERN REGION  

President Nana Addo Dankwa Akufo-Addo, has commissioned three (3) new 40-bed District Hospitals on Wednesday, 4th December 2024, in the Eastern Region of the country.  

Having already commissioned four of such hospitals in the Ashanti region late last month, these three latest additions located in the Okere District, Jumapo, in the  New Juaben North Municipality and Kwabeng, in the Atiwa West District, are part of a total of twelve 40-bed Hospitals in Ashanti, Eastern, Greater Accra region and one Polyclinic at Mim, in the Brong Ahafo region. 

Former Health Minister, Kwaku Agyeman Manu, in 2020 broke the ground for work to commence on these hospital projects which was undertaken by VAMED Engineering GmbH of Austria. 

Other areas where these hospitals have been built across the country include Drobonso, Twedie, Sabronum, Suame, Manso Nkwanta, Nkwatia, Achiase, Mim and Kpone Katamanso

A €71,500,000 Euro facility was secured from Erste Group Bank AG and Česká Spořitelna a.s towards the construction and equipping of these 40-bed hospitals, which also includes 12-units of 2-bedroom semi-detached accommodation for hospital workers at each of the facilities. 

Aside the residential accomodation for the staff of the hospitals, the hospitals are equipped with an Out-Patient Department with the requisite consulting rooms, Public Health Department with 36-seater capacity waiting room, three ante-natal consulting rooms, a counselling room and two offices for Public Health Officers. 

It also includes a theatre consisting of one Surgical Suite, 8-bed Paediatric Ward, 8-bed Male Ward, 8-bed Female Ward, four Labour Delivery stations, 8-bed Maternity Ward, 4-bed Lying-in and 2-bed Recovery room.

President Akufo-Addo urged the staff and the people of the areas to ensure that the facilities are adequately administered and maintained to ensure that governments commitment to improving the health status of all residents in the country through improving health care infrastructure is realised.

Dalaba, 25 octobre 2024 – Le #Gouvernement guinéen, par l’entremise du Ministère de la Culture, du Tourisme et de l’Artisanat Guinée, se donne pour mission de dynamiser le secteur touristique et de valoriser le patrimoine naturel et culturel du pays. Dans cette perspective, l’Office National du Tourisme a officiellement lancé ce vendredi la saison touristique 2024. Cette année, la préfecture de Dalaba, célèbre pour ses nombreux sites d’intérêt, a eu l'honneur d'accueillir cet événement marquant, organisé dans le cadre pittoresque du Tinka Eco-Village.

Le choix de Dalaba pour cette édition traduit également l'engagement des autorités à promouvoir un tourisme durable. Il s’agit de favoriser des pratiques respectueuses de l’environnement et de soutenir les initiatives locales de préservation. Dotée d’un climat doux et tempéré, de collines verdoyantes, de vallées pittoresques et de forêts denses, Dalaba offre un cadre enchanteur pour les visiteurs.

Les amateurs d’histoire et de nature pourront y découvrir des sites emblématiques tels que les chutes de Ditin, le site historique de Fougoumba, lieu de couronnement des Almamy du Fouta théocratique, la stèle de René Caillé, ou encore la villa de Miriam Makéba.

DIPLOMATIE : Six nouveaux ambassadeurs présentent leurs lettres de créance au Président de la Transition

Le jeudi 28 novembre 2024, six nouveaux ambassadeurs ont présenté leurs lettres de créance au Président de la Transition, Son Excellence le Général d’Armée Assimi GOITA, Chef de l’État. 

Le premier diplomate reçu est le nouvel Ambassadeur de l’Union européenne au Mali. SE Thomas ECKERT, précédemment Ambassadeur de l’Union européenne à Alger, est un diplomate de carrière dont les premières expériences ont été acquises en Allemagne dans son pays. Avant sa nomination à Alger, il était depuis 2019, Conseiller au Cabinet de la Commissaire européenne à la Cohésion reformes à Bruxelles. Il détient un doctorat et un master en histoire. 
Le nouveau chef de la représentation égyptienne au Mali s’appelle désormais SE Mohamed El GAMMAL. Le diplômé en Sciences politiques, diplomatie et relations internationales des Universités du Caire et de Madrid, a occupé plusieurs postes de responsabilité au niveau du département central du ministère en charge des Affaires étrangères ainsi que dans les représentations diplomatiques et postes consulaires de l’Égypte en Colombie et en Espagne.
Le Président de la Transition a également reçu la lettre de créance du nouvel ambassadeur du Congo au Mali. Il se nomme Pr Luc Jean Saint-Vito AKA EVY. Diplomate et écrivain congolais né en 1952 à Brazzaville. Professeur titulaire d’université, il a longtemps été directeur général des Arts et Lettres au ministère des Arts et de la Culture de la République du Congo. Il fut également Ambassadeur du Congo auprès de la République du Sénégal. SE Luc Jean Saint-Vito AKA EVY est Commandeur dans l’Ordre du Mérite congolais et Chevalier dans l’ordre du Mérite universitaire. Il est âgé de 72 ans.
Le quatrième diplomate reçu ce jeudi est SE Christophe MUZUNGU, nouvel ambassadeur de la République Démocratique du Congo au Mali. SE Christophe MUZUNGU, qui a désormais en charge de maintenir les relations historiques entre notre pays et la République du Congo, a plusieurs diplômes supérieurs. Il est bien connu dans le paysage universitaire et politique de son pays. Il fut Ambassadeur de la République Démocratique du Congo à Brazzaville et Doyen du corps diplomatique. SE Christophe a occupé le poste de vice-ministre de la Jeunesse et du Sport (2002-2003) avant de devenir ministre de la Culture et de l’Art (2004-2006). Il a aussi à son actif plusieurs ouvrages et il fut avocat près de la Cour d’Appel, Parlementaire et Gouverneur de la Ville de Kinshasa.
Le nouvel ambassadeur de la Gambie au Mali était aussi à ce rendez-vous de présentation des lettres de créance. SE Hadrammeh M. SIDIBEH est né le 29 avril 1957. Avant son accréditation pour servir au Mali, le diplomate Gambien était le Chef de la représentation de son pays à Dakar, au Sénégal. Sa mission : raffermir davantage les relations de coopération bilatérales entre le Mali et la Gambie.
Le cortège diplomatique du jeudi 28 novembre 2024 a pris fin par la présentation des lettres de créance du nouvel ambassadeur de la Fédération de Malaisie au Mali. L’Ambassadeur Zainal Izran ZAHARI est un diplomate reconnu avec une vingtaine d’années d’expérience. Il a servi comme chef de mission adjoint et ministre auprès de l’Union européenne. Il fut également Représentant permanent de la Malaisie auprès des Nations Unies et autres organisations internationales en Autriche.

RECONNAISSANCE DU MÉRITE : Un Mémorial en hommage aux héros tombés pour la patrie

Le projet de construction d’un Mémorial dédié à la mémoire des militaires tombés sur le champ d’honneur a été présenté ce jeudi 16 janvier 2025 au Président de la Transition, Chef de l’État, Chef Suprême des Armées, le Général d’Armée Assimi GOÏTA. Ce complexe sera un lieu de mémoire destiné à conserver durablement le souvenir des hauts faits des valeureuses filles et fils du Mali tombés pour la patrie.

Le projet sera réalisé sur un site situé dans la Commune urbaine de Kati, sur une parcelle d’environ 11 hectares. Ce nouveau joyau comprendra un monument appelé « Le Mirador », symbolisant à la fois la résistance, la bravoure et la reconnaissance éternelle de la patrie envers ses militaires. Ce monument servira également de lien entre deux mondes : celui des vivants et celui des disparus. Des stèles y seront érigées pour honorer les militaires tombés, avec les noms des héros inscrits, retraçant ainsi les différentes étapes de l’histoire de l’armée nationale.

Le Musée des Armées sera une composante majeure de ce projet de Mémorial. Il s’agira d’un bâtiment à deux niveaux (rez-de-chaussée + 1er étage), destiné à accueillir des expositions permanentes et temporaires. Une particularité de ce musée résidera dans l’existence d’espaces ouverts où seront exposés des objets spécifiques, tels que des aéronefs, des engins de combat et des véhicules de transport militaires. Par ailleurs, le complexe comprendra des ateliers dédiés au Musée des Armées, un bloc administratif, un restaurant et un poste de police.

Le Ministre de la Défense et des Anciens Combattants, le Général de Corps d’Armée Sadio CAMARA, s’est réjoui de ce projet, saluant la décision du Chef de l’État d’ériger un Mémorial pour immortaliser les sacrifices des valeureux guerriers de l’Histoire du Mali. Selon lui, ce projet constitue une contribution essentielle à la sauvegarde de la mémoire nationale, de la dignité collective, de la conscience patriotique, ainsi que de la souveraineté et de l’honneur du Mali.

« C’est avec une profonde émotion que nous nous réunissons aujourd’hui pour lancer la construction du Mémorial dédié aux militaires tombés sur le champ d’honneur, qui sera érigé à Kati, ville garnison ayant vu tant de soldats s’engager et sacrifier leur vie pour protéger notre liberté et notre souveraineté. Grâce à cet édifice emblématique, qui occupera une place de choix dans les célébrations nationales, plus aucun Malien n’ignorera l’héritage des vaillants guerriers qui ont façonné notre histoire et notre identité », a déclaré le Ministre CAMARA.

Il a également mis en lumière les efforts de modernisation et de transformation des Forces Armées Maliennes (FAMa) sous la direction du Général d’Armée Assimi GOÏTA, soulignant que ces efforts ont permis de former des milliers de soldats professionnels et aguerris. « Aujourd’hui, grâce à la symbiose entre l’armée et la nation que vous avez suscitée, le Mali est défendu par 22 millions de citoyens-soldats prêts à donner leur vie pour protéger l’honneur et la dignité retrouvés de notre pays. Tous ne verront pas leurs noms gravés dans ce mémorial, mais tous contribuent à bâtir la gloire et la grandeur du Mali », a-t-il affirmé.

La cérémonie de présentation du projet a enregistré la présence du Président du Conseil National de Transition, des membres du Gouvernement, l’Inspecteur Général des Armées et Services, le Chef d’État-Major Général des Armées, ainsi que de nombreux officiers généraux, Chefs d’état-major et Directeurs de services des Forces de Défense et de Sécurité, sans oublier les anciens combattants.

Koulouba | 14 février 2025 | #vœux

NOUVEL AN : Vœux du personnel de la Présidence au Chef de l’État
 
Le personnel de la Présidence a présenté, ses vœux de Nouvel An, ce vendredi 14 février 2025, au Président de la Transition, SE le Général d’Armée Assimi GOÏTA, Chef de l’État.
 
Cette cérémonie, au-delà de son caractère symbolique, est une preuve du dévouement et de l’engagement du personnel de la Présidence au côté du Chef de l’État pour œuvrer ensemble pour la grandeur de la patrie.
 
Au nom de l’ensemble du personnel, le Ministre Secrétaire Général de la Présidence, Dr Alfousseyni DIAWARA, a présenté au Chef de l’État, ainsi qu’à sa famille des vœux de bonheur, de succès, de longévité et de santé.
 
Il a mis l’occasion à profit pour rappeler quelques hauts faits ayant impacté positivement la vie de la Nation durant l’année écoulée, notamment la lutte implacable contre la corruption, l’élaboration d’une Charte pour la paix et la réconciliation nationale, la réforme et la gouvernance minière, la montée en puissance des Forces de défense et de sécurité et les réformes institutionnelles et politiques. Le ministre a également souligné l’importance des Œuvres sociales du Chef de l’État, véritable source d’espoir pour les couches vulnérables partout sur le territoire national.
 
Dr Alfousseyni DIAWARA a réitéré à Son Excellence le Président de la Transition, l’engagement indéfectible du personnel de la Présidence. Il a salué à juste titre la nomination de certains collaborateurs aux plus hautes fonctions, notamment comme Ministre, Ambassadeur ou même membre des Commissions de travail dans le cadre des réformes institutionnelles.
 
Le Président de la Transition a salué le cadre d’échanges convivial que représente cette cérémonie dans le renforcement des liens de collaboration. Le Général d’Armée Assimi GOÏTA s’est également réjoui de la constance des efforts de ses collaborateurs pour veiller à la bonne utilisation des ressources de l’État, qui dénote d’un engagement collectif en faveur de la transparence et de l’efficacité.
 
En raison des défis énormes auxquels fait face notre pays, il a exhorté le personnel à continuer à s’approprier, dans leurs tâches quotidiennes, les trois principes constitutionnels qui guident l’action publique au Mali. « C’est en se conformant à ces principes que chaque Malienne et chaque Malien réussira à conforter sa citoyenneté », a-t-il poursuivi.

A proposta do Executivo para alterar as tabelas salariais da função pública, que prevê um aumento de 25 por cento com efeitos retroactivos a partir de Janeiro deste ano, já foi enviada à Assembleia Nacional.

O documento, apreciado esta segunda-feira, 13 de Janeiro, pela Comissão Económica do Conselho de Ministros, é parte dos esforços  para corrigir disparidades salariais e valorizar a hierarquia entre as carreiras na Administração Pública.

SINISTRALIDADE RODOVIÁRIA
Luanda, Huíla, Huambo e Zaire registaram maior número de acidentes em 2024

As províncias de Luanda, Huíla, Huambo e Zaire registaram mais acidentes de trânsito em 2024, segundo o ministro do Interior, Manuel Homem, nesta quarta-feira, 2 de Abril, em Luanda.

A informação foi prestada no final da Iª Sessão Ordinária do Conselho Nacional de Viação e Ordenamento do Trânsito (CNVOT), orientada pela Vice-Presidente da República, Esperança da Costa.

Os acidentes ocorreram com maior frequência em zonas urbanas e as principais causas são a condução em estado de embriaguez, excesso de velocidade, a não cedência de passagem, manobras perigosas, excesso de lotação e de carga.

Além disso, o uso irregular de acessórios de segurança e do telemóvel, bem como a circulação de veículos em mau estado de conservação, contribuíram significativamente para o aumento da sinistralidade rodoviária no país.

Para mitigar a sinistralidade rodoviária, o Governo pretende implementar medidas como a criação da Unidade Especial de Segurança Rodoviária e o reforço do controlo de velocidade por meio de radares e dispositivos inteligentes.

A aquisição de equipamentos auxiliares de fiscalização, como radares, alcoolímetros e opacímetros, além da actualização da sinalização rodoviária conforme o regulamento em vigor, também estão entre as medidas a serem implementadas.

O CNVOT apreciou, ainda, a implementação das acções previstas para 2024, no âmbito do Plano Nacional de Prevenção e Segurança Rodoviária 2023-2027, estabelecido pelo Decreto Presidencial nº 145/23, de 30 de Junho.

Entre as iniciativas discutidas, destaca-se o Projecto de Regulamento Sobre o Uso do Aparelho Metrológico Radares, que visa regular a instalação e utilização dos dispositivos ao longo das vias do país para monitorizar os limites de velocidade.

Manuel Homem disse ainda que, a implementação deste projecto está em fase experimental na província de Luanda, onde já estão a ser utilizados radares móveis para testar a eficácia dos equipamentos.

O CNVOT, como órgão de consulta do Titular do Poder Executivo em matérias de viação e ordenamento do trânsito, também foi informado sobre os resultados do Iº Fórum Internacional Sobre Segurança Rodoviária em Angola. 

Durante o encontro, abordou-se ainda a inclusão de conteúdos programáticos de educação rodoviária no currículo académico, uma medida que visa reforçar a formação dos estudantes em matéria de segurança no trânsito.

“O Comando-Geral da Polícia, por meio dos órgãos de viação e trânsito, tem realizado campanhas de sensibilização em parceria com o Ministério da Educação, levando a temática da segurança rodoviária para as escolas em todo o país”, afirmou Manuel Homem.

كما أشاد بجهود القوافل الطبية التي زارت 12 مدينة ليبية، وقدمت خدمات الكشف والرعاية لأكثر من 30,000 حالة، ونفذت 3,500 عملية جراحية، بالإضافة إلى إنجازات هيئة زراعة القرنية التي نجحت في إجراء 1,000 عملية زراعة قرنية في مختلف مدن ليبيا، معتبراً هذه الجهود نموذجًا للتفاني والعمل الجماعي.

وأشار الدبيبة إلى أن هذه المناسبة ليست فقط للاحتفاء بالإنجازات، بل تؤكد التزام الحكومة بدعم المبادرات التي تسهم في تطوير القطاع الصحي ورفع مستوى الرعاية الصحية.

Waxaan ummadda Islaamka, gaar ahaan shacabka Soomaaliyeed meel kasta oo aad joogtaan idiin kugu hambalyeynayaa munaasabadda barakaysan ee Ciidul-Fidri.

Waxaa si gaar ah ugu hambalyeynayaa geesiyaasha Soomaaliyeed ee ku sugan furimaha hore ee dagaalka – Ciidamada Qalabka Sida ee naftooda u huray difaaca diinta, dalka, dadkooda, iyo ciribtirka argagixisada Khawaarijta ee dhibaatada ku haysa dalkeenna.

Guulaha ay ciidamadeennu ka soo hooyeen jiidaha dagaalka waa astaan muujinaysa dadaalka iyo go’aanka shacabka Soomaaliyeed ee ah in aysan mar dambe aqbali doonin cadow gumaada dadkooda oo hor istaaga horumarkooda.

Waxaa farriinteyda ciiddeed saldhig u ah in aynu garab istaagno ciidamadeenna, u duceyno, una dardaaranno midnimo, is-cafis, iyo in aynu si wadajir ah u wajahno cadowga dalkeenna.

Ilaahay ha idinka aqbalo soonkii, salaaddii, sadaqadii iyo acmaashii wanaagsanayd ee bisha Ramadaan.

Ciid wanaagsan!

Waxaan si mugleh uga mahad celinayaa soo dhaweyntii milgaha lahayd ee naloo sameeyey aniga iyo Wafdigeyga, SSC-Khaatumo waa maamul iyo deegaan Soomaaliyeed oo ka tirsan dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, mana ahan meel lagu muransan yahay.

Bismillahi

Waxaan hambalyo iyo salaan diirran u dirayaa dhammaan shacabka Soomaaliyeed iyo guud ahaan Muslimiinta adduunka, maalinta sharafta leh ee dhalashada Nabigeena Muxamed (Naxariis iyo Nabadgelyo korkiisa ha ahaatee).

Maalintaan barakeysan waa fursad aan ku xasuusanno naxariista, jacaylka iyo caddaalada uu Nabigu u muujiyay Aadanaha. Waa in aan ku dayano wanaagga iyo dhaqanka suuban ee Nabiga, kuna dayano tilmaamihiisa qiimaha badan.

Waxaan Alle weydiisaneynaa in uu nagu karaameeyo Xuska Nabi Muxamed (NNKH) oo naga yeelo kuwa raaca sunnadiisa. Waxaan Ummadda soomaaliyeed ugu baaqayaa  in ay ilaaliyaan midnimada, wadajirka iyo walaalnimada dhexdooda ah.

Hambalyo iyo duco ayaan u dirayaa wiilkayga Aadan Xuseen Rooble iyo gabadhayda Jihaan Xasan oo Caasimadda Muqdisho aan ku agaasinnay gurigooda.

Qoyska cusub waxaan Alle uga rajeynayaa  in uu isu barakeeyo oo ay kala helaan nolol wanaagsan iyo farxad waarta.

Innaa lillaahi wa innaa ileyhi Raajicuun. 

Waxaan tacsi tiiraanyo leh u dirayaa qoyska, qaraabada iyo guud ummadda Soomaaliyeed ee uu ka baxay Alle ha u naxariistee Madaxweynihii hore ee Somaliland Marxuum Axmed Maxamed Maxamuud (Siilaanyo) oo caawa ku geeriyooday magaalada Hargaysa.

Waa geeri xanuun badan oo ay si weyn ay u wada dareemeen shacabka Soomaaliyeed meelkasta oo ay joogaan. Alle ha u naxariistee Madaxweyne Siilaanyo, waxa uu door weyn ka soo qaatay dowladnimada Soomaaliya oo uu mas’uuliyado kala duwan ugu soo adeegay, laga soo billaabo dowladdii Rayidka ahayd iyo dowladdii Kacaanka oo uu labo Wasaarad Wasiir kasoo noqday.

Marxuumku waxa aan ku xusuusanaynaa doorkiisii lama ilaawaanka ahaa ee uu kasoo qaatay furitaankii albaabka wadahadallada Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo Somaliland si xal waara looga gaaro tabashada walaalaha Gobolada Waqooyi.

Waxaan Alle u weydiinayaa Marxuumka in uu hoygiisa ka yeelo Jannatul Firdowsa, samir iyo iimaanna uu ka siiyo qoyskiisa iyo guud ahaan ummadda Soomaaliyeed ee uu ka geeriyooday.

Innaa lillaahi wa innaa ileyhi Raajicuun.

Maanta, waxaan garoonka diyaaradaha ee Aadan Cadde kusoo dhaweeyay qaar ka mid ah geesiyaasha Ciidanka Qaranka Soomaaliyeed iyo xoogagga shacbiga ah ee ku dhaawacmay howlgallada lagu ciribtirayo haraadiga Khawaarijta.

Waxaan naga go’an in ciidamada dhaawacma ay helaan daryeel dhameystiran. Waxay naftooda u huraan difaaca dalka iyo badbaadinta shacabka, waana waajib in aan garab istaagno, daryeelno, una muujino in naf-hurnimadooda aan la iloobi doonin.

Waxaan bogaadinayaa sida geesinimada leh ee halyeeyadan ay ugu huraan naftooda gobanimada iyo xoreynta dadka Soomaaliyeed. Waxaan Alle uga baryayaa inuu siiyo caafimaad degdeg ah, si ay dib ugu soo kabtaan.

Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya waxay sii xoojinaysaa qorsheyaasha horumarinta adeegyada caafimaadka ee Ciidanka Xoogga Dalka, iyadoo la ballaarinayo iskaashiga caalamiga ah si loo helo taageero dheeri ah oo lagu daryeelo ciidamada dhaawaca ah. Waa waajib qaran in la hubiyo in geesiyaasheenna ay helaan daryeelka ay mudan yihiin.

Innaa lillaahi wa innaa ilayhi raajicuun

Waxaan tacsi tiiraanyo leh u dirayaa qoyskii, qaraabadii, bahda Ciidanka Booliska Soomaaliyeed, iyo guud ahaan ummadda Soomaaliyeed ee uu ka baxay Allaha u naxariistee Janaraal Maxamed Yuusuf Sheekh Cumar (Madaale). 

Geerida Janaraalku waa mid qaran oo si weyn u taabaneysa shacabka Soomaaliyeed iyo hay’adaha amniga dalka. Marxuumku waxa uu door muhiim ah ka soo qaatay dib u dhiska dowladnimada, gaar ahaan horumarinta iyo tayeynta Ciidanka Booliska Soomaaliyeed, isagoo naf iyo niyadba u huray u adeeggida qaranka.

Waxaan Alle uga baryayaa inuu marxuumka naxariistiisa janno ka waraabiyo, ehelkiisii, asxaabtiisii iyo dhammaan shacabka Soomaaliyeedna samir iyo iimaan ka siiyo.

#ChristmasBundlesOfJoy The Free State Province welcomed 79 babies (37 female and 41 male) born at our public health facilities between 00:01 - 08:00 on this Christmas day. Babies born on Christmas day always have a very special place in our celebrations on the day.

• Twins (boy and a girl) were born to Ms Lire Lebohang from Ladybrand at 13:24 and 13:27 at Pelonomi Tertiary Hospital. 
• Ten babies each were born at the Pelonomi Tertiary Hospital and Bongani Regional Hospital in Welkom
• The Mangaung Metro and Thabo Mofutsanyana Health Districts each has 25 babies born at their health facilities. Lejweleputswa health district: 14, Fezile Dabi health district 13 and Xhariep health district 2.
• 8 babies were born to mothers considered to be 19 years of age and younger.
• The last baby born on Christmas day was a boy at 23:50, born to Ms Annah Phajane at the Diamant District Hospital in Jagersfontein, Xhariep district.

We urge all new mothers across the province to ensure that they breastfeed exclusively, at least for the first six months of their lives.  Breastmilk continues to be an important source of nutrients to children after 6 months, therefore there is no need to put a time limit on feeds. Where breastfeeding is not practical mothers are encouraged to express the breastmilk and cup feed, because breast milk has major health benefits - such as strengthening the baby's immune system. It also creates a strong bond between the mother and the baby. 

Mothers should also ensure that the babies get necessary immunisations from birth, and always remember to take their SidebySide Road-To-Health-Booklet, previously known as Clinic Card to hospital or clinic as it keeps track of your child’s immunisation which shows doctors and nurses your child growth.

The Department also offers support to mothers through #MomConnect. For answers to all your baby questions, dial *134*550*2# or send 'Connect' WhatsApp to 0796312456.
